about.text: Cream with at least 36 % milkfat, the richest of the creams defined in the United States, often sold as heavy whipping cream.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Cream standardised to at least 36 % milkfat and heat-treated; US law allows stabilisers, which is why some cartons contain them.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

facts.v: Pasteurised or ultra-pasteurised; the label must say so
Heavy cream or heavy whipping cream
